question_text: A 23-year-old man presents to the office complaining of weight loss and fatigue for the past 2 months. He states that he has been experiencing foul-smelling, light-colored stools but thinks it is because he hasn’t been eating well, recently. He has a past medical history significant for cystic fibrosis, which is well-controlled medically. He denies any shortness of breath, chest or abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, or melena. On physical examination, his skin is pale and dry. Which of the following would be the most likely etiology of a malabsorption syndrome giving rise to this patient’s current condition?
